'''Christian P. Robert''' is a French statistician, specializing in [[Bayesian statistics]] and [[Monte Carlo]] methods.

== Career ==

Christian Robert studied at [[ENSAE ParisTech|ENSAE]] then defended his PhD in 1987 at [[Université de Rouen]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=56675|title=Christian Robert - The Mathematics Genealogy Project}}</ref> He held temporary positions at [[Purdue]] and [[Cornell]] before being  an associate professor at [[Paris 6|Université Paris 6]], and then Professor at [[Université de Rouen]]. He was also Professor of Statistics at [[École Polytechnique]] and director of [[Center for Research in Economics and Statistics]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ceremade.dauphine.fr/%7Exian/basics.html|title=Christian P. Robert Basics}}</ref>
As of 2021, he is professor at [[CEREMADE]], [[Université Paris-Dauphine]] and a part-time member of the Department of Statistics, [[University of Warwick]].

== Works ==

Christian Robert is the author of several textbooks on Bayesian inference and Monte Carlo methods, including:

* Robert, Christian. ''The Bayesian choice: from decision-theoretic foundations to computational implementation''. Springer Science & Business Media, 2007.
* Robert, Christian, and [[George Casella]]. ''Monte Carlo statistical methods''. Springer Science & Business Media, 2013.
* Marin, Jean-Michel, and Christian P. Robert. ''Bayesian essentials with R''. New York: Springer, 2014.

== Service ==

Robert served as the [[editor in chief]] of the [[Journal of the Royal Statistical Society]], Series B, from 2006 to 2009. He was president of the [[International Society for Bayesian Analysis]] in 2008. In 2016 he was joint program chair of the [[AIStats]] conference.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://aistats.org/aistats2016/organizers.html|title=AIStats 2016 organizers}}</ref>

== Awards ==
* Fellow of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://imstat.org/honored-ims-fellows/|title=Institute of Mathematical Statistics - Honored IMS Fellows}}</ref> (1996)
* Fellow of the [[Royal Statistical Society]] (1998)
* [[International Society for Bayesian Analysis]] DeGroot prize for ''the Bayesian Choice'' (2003)<ref>{{cite web|url=https://bayesian.org/project/degroot-prize/|title=DeGroot prize}}</ref>
* Fellow of the [[American Statistical Association]] (2012)
* Fellow of the [[International Society for Bayesian Analysis]] (2014)<ref>{{cite web|url=https://bayesian.org/membership/isba-fellows/|title=ISBA Fellows}}</ref>
* Akaike Memorial Lecture Award 2026
